## 1. Overall health assessment

Surface metrics look excellent (98.6% closure, only 68 open, zero aged showstoppers), but they're misleading: **the showstopper field isn't being used**, and at least eight open `PROD[BUG]` tickets — including case filing and order-signing failures — sit in `no status` or `In Progress`. The real picture is a team that closes tickets well but has lost control of triage hygiene: 79% of open issues are stale and 13 have no status at all, so the dashboard can't be trusted as a risk signal.
